milestone.label: v0.16 - Supabase auth + Stripe subscriptions + live TICA data pipeline

items: RE-ANCHORED 2026-08-24 without moving the number, and the reason is the point. Releases v0.17.11 through v0.17.28 shipped since the 2026-07-03 anchor and the engineering was real: per-user state dual-written to Postgres, migration 0008 and the state-parity probe, the billing sync made loud. None of it closed a gate on this list. Checked each one against the code today. Judge-panel coverage is converging by cron and is ongoing by design, not a gate that closes. The multi-user ownership model is still at the design-document stage and its two blocking questions, the mail sender and the session lifetime, are open decisions. Auth polish is unchanged. On the security line, view-as and sharing still read the key-value store rather than security-definer functions: verified in src/index.js, where the view-as branch reads KV and says so in its own comment. So 76 is still the honest figure and the date now says when that was last checked rather than when it was last true. Do not read a flat number as a stalled project; read it as four gates that none of the last seventeen releases were aimed at.
Judge-panel coverage polish: intl coverage grows as the daily cron converges; re-check cadence for clubs that post panels late
Multi-user ownership model (docs/AUTH-OWNERSHIP-DESIGN.md): MERGED co-ownership (shared writes both see), email invite notification, reg-number join requests + certificate verification
Auth polish: email OTP code / verification edge cases

Security (docs/SECURITY.md): sprint 2026-06-30..07-02 (v0.17.2-0.17.10). DONE: CSP+headers (run_worker_first), rate limits, audit log, prototype-pollution guard, shared-cat payload sanitization, seed-share owner-check, DB advisor lockdown (migration 0006), judge-rating anti-ballot-stuffing, supabase-js confirmed latest, leaked webhook revoked, rotation runbook. **P1-7 DONE + verified live: per-user state migrated to Postgres user_state with RLS (migration 0007); dual-write KV+PG, STATE_READ=pg flag + KV fallback/lazy-backfill; RLS isolation proven (own-row-only/anon-denied); view-as+sharing stay on KV; cost-neutral (free tier) + cron keep-warm.** **Turnstile widget CREATED + site key wired + deployed (v0.17.12, 2026-07-02): managed-mode widget for ring.yesandeverything.com, TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY var live, /api/config serves it, CSP opens challenges.cloudflare.com, login renders widget + passes captchaToken; verified turnstile.render() accepts the key on the live hostname.** **Turnstile ENFORCING (2026-07-03): Kane pasted the secret into Supabase CAPTCHA; verified live, OTP without captcha_token now returns captcha_failed.** OPEN: full relational cats/shows normalization (optional product-scale), move view-as/sharing reads to DEFINER RPCs. Ring Resources Bot webhook recreated 2026-07-06 (real URL on disk, audit digests posting again).

actions.title: Parse the billing sync response body and throw when the remote call returns false, so an unmatched Stripe customer fails loudly and Stripe retries instead of the entitlement write being dropped forever.
Add authenticated account export and delete endpoints and write a retention policy covering user_state, the key-value ratings, and the audit log.
Stop returning a 200 from the state post handler when the Postgres half of the dual-write failed; answer 502 or ok false so the retry ladder and the not-synced indicator fire.
Give merged leaf values an update stamp and compare it in mergeStates, or add per-item tombstones, so a stale remote array cannot resurrect a deleted target.
Return a discriminated result from the remote-state loader so a failed read cannot be mistaken for a new user and overwritten with stale local state.
Add a Stripe event table keyed by the event id, insert before calling billing sync, and skip duplicate or out-of-order events so a retried update cannot restore a cancelled subscription.
Cache verified tokens for their remaining lifetime or verify them locally against Supabase's published keys, and stop serializing the identity check with the Postgres read on the state endpoint.
Spend the next Ring session only on the v1.0-freeze-versus-Phase-2 scope call and the pricing question, before any further release-script or infrastructure work lands.

Add a release pre-flight that greps every public artifact path for long dashes and a maintained tell-vocabulary list, covering CHANGELOG.md, README.md, PROJECT_SPEC.md and DEPLOY.md, not just the two files under public.
Rewrite the six collective-voice strings in the live app shell to solo first person.
Mirror each judge-rating tally write into Postgres or add a nightly key-value dump, so the one dataset with no copy on any device survives a namespace mistake.
REDACTED: a MED severity finding in the security lens is withheld from the public copy. See this project's own bar-raise report for detail.
Raise or make dynamic the 14-page cap on the standings walk and log when the walk ends by hitting the cap rather than by running out of rows.
Run the Postgres state read concurrently with the identity check in the state get handler, since both need only the bearer token, and discard the read if verification fails.
Extend the section-marker convention through the unsectioned tail of public/app.js so the file matches the module list in PROJECT_SPEC.md end to end.
Either wire readers and writers to the ten-table schema in migration 0001 or park the migration, instead of carrying two parallel data models with one dead.
Add a request timeout signal to the Stripe, Supabase, Discord and Resend fetches the way the TICA fetches already have one.
Wrap the api dispatch in a try/catch that logs the route and returns a JSON 500 carrying the security headers.
Land straight on the single cat's dashboard when the signed-in owner has exactly one cat, instead of rendering the picker grid.
Bump the wrangler development dependency to the major actually resolved at deploy time, install it locally instead of leaning on the package runner, and commit the lockfile.
Post cron and scraper failures to a webhook or a key-value error log using the posting helper that already exists.
Write a last-cron-run marker from the scheduled handler and surface it in the health endpoint, distinct from the calendar-age proxy.
Keep the multi-user ownership tables unwired until the scope decision is actually made, rather than letting dormancy stand in for the call.
Publish a short static privacy and terms page naming the data collected and how long it is kept, and link it from the footer.
Wrap the Step 4 notify call in release.ps1 in the same try/catch used by Steps 3 and 5, so an error there cannot abort the release and skip the audit digests.
Replace the sequential per-grant read loop in the shared-cats handler with a batched read, matching the judge-aggregate handler.
Add the service worker version constant to check-version-pill.ps1 and to the marker list, since that is the exact file that drifted in the 2026-08-14 audit.
Have the post-deploy live check read the response body for the new version or build stamp, not just assert a 200.
Write the vote marker before the tally so a partial failure costs an uncounted vote rather than a double count, and record the accepted read-modify-write race in a comment.
Add CLAUDE.md and .project-context.json to the voice scope and strip the long dash that has landed in .project-context.json since the last hand fix.
Name the shipped Stripe subscriptions in the systems or decisions panel of both Ring pages on the portfolio site.
Spell out the abbreviations that appear in prose across README.md, DEPLOY.md, PROJECT_SPEC.md and CHANGELOG.md.
REDACTED: a MED severity finding in the security lens is withheld from the public copy. See this project's own bar-raise report for detail.

Send an idempotency key derived from the user id on the Stripe customer create, and log the swallowed link write in the customer helper instead of discarding it.
Re-arm the state push from the online listener and from a visibility-change handler, so offline edits do not wait for an unrelated change to sync.
Have the profile lookup tell a transport failure apart from an empty result and treat the failure as entitled with a logged error, so a Supabase blip does not paywall a paying subscriber.
Refuse the calendar cache write when the new show count falls well below the previous one, so a partial parse cannot replace a good calendar and discard carried judge panels.
Move the long-dash scan into verify.ps1 or a shared function, so it runs on every commit rather than only on a full release.
Log once per fail-open branch in the rate limiter, naming the bucket, so a dead ratings binding is visible.
Read the rate-limit counter before writing it and only write near the threshold, so gated traffic stops multiplying key-value writes one for one.
Record the vendored Supabase client version and pull date in a header comment on public/vendor/supabase.js.
Log a warning in the remote-state loader's catch so a failed boot-time read leaves a trace.
Log inside the Postgres read failure paths and branch on the result, so a broken read path is distinguishable from an unmigrated user.
Re-run the portfolio page stamper so the Ring version pill stops reading three patch versions behind.
Cap the per-request standings page walk and backfill the rest in the background, so one request's processor time does not scale with season depth.
Adopt the versioned-prefix pattern the standings cache already uses, or document near the key builders that a shape change needs a versioned prefix and a read-time fallback.

deferred.title: Decide a v1.0 freeze against a scoped Phase-2 milestone (ownership, invites, certificate verification).
Revisit pricing and unit economics; a dollar a month needs roughly 500 users to cover hosting.
Judge-panel coverage polish, one-time-code edge cases, and the remaining relational normalization.
deferred.reason: hold until the v1.0 and Phase-2 scope decision resolves
